senses.gloss:
f. (-गीः)
1 Speech, speaking.
2 A name of SARASVATĪ the goddess of speech.
3 Fame, celebrity.
E.
गॄ to sound, affix क्विप्, ॠ is changed to इर्.

n. (-णं)
Swallowing.
E.
गॄ to swallow, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-रा)
Speech.
E.
गॄ to sound, क, and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि)
Venerable, respectable, worshipful.
m. (-रिः)
1 A mountain, a hill.
2 A wooden ball with which children play.
3 A disease of the eyes.
f. (-रिः)
1 Swallowing.
2 A small rat, a mouse.
3 A title given to one order of the Dāsnāmī Gosains.
E.
गॄ to swallow, &c. इ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and कण्टक a thorn, tearing or splitting rocks.

m. (-म्बः)
A species of Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba.)
E.
गिरि, and कदम्ब the same.

m. (-रः)
A cave, a cavern.
E.
गिरि, and कन्दर a cave.

f. (-ली)
A species of plantain growing in hilly countries.
E.
गिरि, and कदली a plantain.

f. (-का)
The earth.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and कर्ण an ear, affixes कन् and टाप्; the mountain-eared.

f. (-र्णी)
1 A plant, commonly Javāsa, (Hedysarum alhaji.)
2 A different plant, (Clitoria ternatea): see अपराजिता.
E.
गिरि a mouse, and कर्णी an ear, affix ङीष्, the mouse-earleaved.

f. (-का)
A small rat, a mouse.
E.
कन् added to गिरि the same.

m. (-णः)
A blind or one-eyed man, one blind from a particular disease.
E.
गिरि as above, and काण one-eyed.

m. (-डः)
A ball for playing with.
E.
गिरि, and गुड, each meaning the same thing, a ball.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Mountain-born, mountaineer, &c.
m. (-जः)
The Mahwa tree, (Bassia.)
f. (-जा)
1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ, as the daughter of the personified HIMĀLA mountain.
2 The Shaddock or pamplemouse^1, (Citrus decumana.)
3 A plant considered as a white species of Rasnā: see रास्ना.
4 The hill plantain.
5 Jasmine.
6 A pebble, a small stone.
n. (-जं)
1 Talc.
2 Benzoin or gum benjamin; it is also confounded with styrax, another gum resin.
3 Bitumen.
4 Iron.
E.
गिरि, and ज born.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-लं)
Talc.
E.
गिरिज mountain-born, and अमल clear, clean; also गिरिज, and अमल severally.

m. (-रः)
The thunderbolt.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and ज्वर what burns.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Eaten.
2 Swallowed.
E.
गॄ to swallow, affix क्त; also गिलित.

n. (-र्गं)
A hill fort or any strong hold amongst mountains.
E.
गिरि, and दुर्ग a place of difficult access.

m. (-तुः)
Red chalk.
E.
गिरि, and धातु a mineral.

m. (-जः)
A thunderbolt.
E.
गिरि, and ध्वज a banner.

n. (-कं)
Bitumen.
E.
गिरि, and पुष्प a flower; कन् affix of similitude.

n. (-ष्ठं)
The top of a hill.
E.
गिरि, and पृष्ठ back.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fond of or frequenting mountains.
f. (-या)
The Yak.
E.
गिरि, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Echites antidysenterica): see कुटज.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and मल्ली a jasmin, कन् affix of similitude.

m. (-नः)
A large and powerful elephant.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and मान measure, like a mountain in bulk.

m. (-भित्)
A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.)
E.
गिरि, and भिद् what breaks.

mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु)
Mountaineer, mountain-born.
f. (-भूः)
PĀRVATĪ.
m. (-भूः)
A small stone.
E.
गिरि, and भू born.

f. (-मृत्)
1 Red chalk.
2 Mountain-soil.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and मृत् clay, earth.

n. (-वं)
Red chalk.
E.
गिरिमृत्, and भव produced.

m. (-दः)
A foetid mimosa.
E.
गिरि, and मेद filth.

m. (-कः)
A ball for playing with.
E.
गिरि a ball, घ pleonastic affix, and कन् added; also गिरियाक the pen, being lengthened.

m. (-कः)
A ball: see the preceding.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Living in the mountains, being or produced in them.
m. (-सी)
A large kind of Arum.
E.
गिरि, and वासिन् what abides.

m. (-शः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and शीङ्^1 to sleep, affix ड; inhabiting mount Kailāsa, or frequenting the Himāla range.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320. note: Wil1819 also shows Y. But under SI, only 'N' appears..

m. (-शः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A name of Himāla, the snowy mountains on the north of Hindustan, or the range personified.
3 A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
गिरि a mountain, (or in the last meaning, गिर् speech,) and ईश lord.

f. (-नी)
A plant, (Clitoria ternatea.)
E.
गिरि, and शालिनी what grows in.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A name of GAṆEŚA.
2 The peak of a mountain.
E.
गिरि a mount, and शृङ्ग a peak, alluding to his bulk, or गिरि the mountain Kailāsa, and शृङ्ग chief.

m. (-रः)
1 The Malaya mountains, situated in the south of India.
2 Iron.
3 Tin.
E.
गिरि a mountain, and सार essence.

f. (-ता)
PĀRVATĪ.
E.
गिरि Himālaya, and सुता daughter.

m. (-थः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
गी speech, and रथ a car, the conveyer of words.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Praised.
2 Swallowed.
E.
गॄ to swallow or make known, affix क्त.

f. (-र्णिः)
1 Swallowing.
2 Fame, celebrity.
3 Praise, applause.
E.
गॄ to swallow, &c. affix क्तिन्.

f. (-वी)
The goddess SARASVATĪ.
E.
गी speech, and देवी a goddess, the goddess of language.

m. (-णः)
A deity, a god.
E.
गीः speech, and वाण an arrow or weapon in general, whose fiat or word is his weapon; or गी with वन to desire, affix अन्, desiring hymns, prayers, &c. it is also written गीर्ब्बाण^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161210. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 306. note: alternate form of gIrvvARa.
